# Lyrics parsers

@braccato/parsers 0.4.0 (MIT), the TTML/enhanced-LRC/QRC parsers used by Better Lyrics. Bundled locally for the extension service worker. No remote code. See parsers.LICENSE.txt and parsers.package-lock.json for bundled licenses and exact dependencies.

Rebuild: `node tools/build-parsers.mjs` (Node 22+). Upstream: https://github.com/better-lyrics/braccato
